//: Environment boundary for the automation lane. This lane is the transport-neutral host port an automation object model programs against, and its whole purpose is that a server can run the same document operations a browser does. The `lib` here deliberately OMITS DOM: a `document`, `window` or `HTMLElement` reference anywhere in this lane — or in anything it imports — must fail to COMPILE, not merely trip a text scan. That is also why the lane may import only `store`: pulling in binding, output or editor would drag a DOM dependency in through a type.
